text: Which consultancies in Brisbane are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

result.keyword: Which consultancies in Brisbane are best for business workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate implementation?

items.markdown:
`Several prominent consultancies and digital specialists` operate out of Brisbane with a core focus on business process automation, workflow design, and Microsoft Power Automate implementation:

- **Breadcrumb Digital** : Located on Queen Street in Brisbane City, they specialise exclusively in the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Their team focuses on making information systems easier to manage and collaborate on, offering targeted delivery across Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and Microsoft Teams.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHBIaCgNwdnESE0Nnd3ZaeTh4Y0hBeWRIZG9abTQYCg)
- **CG TECH** : Headquartered on Eagle Street in Brisbane City, CG TECH is a dedicated digital transformation and automation consultancy . While technology-agnostic (spanning Microsoft as well as generative AI tools), they focus extensively on practical business process automation and enterprise-grade Power Platform implementation designed to reduce manual workloads for teams.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdneU5HTmlibUpvGAo)
- **[Power Platform Experts](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-brisbane) / Office Experts Group** : A specialized Australian Microsoft consulting group with a strong local Brisbane presence. They provide end-to-end low-code solutions centered around Microsoft-certified expertise in Power Automate workflow deployment, database integration, Power Apps, and Power BI dashboards.[[1]](https://www.powerplatformexperts.com.au/power-platform-consultants-brisbane)
- **Applecart Digital** : Operating out of Queen Street, Brisbane, Applecart Digital caters heavily to small-to-medium enterprises looking to extract more value out of the Microsoft 365 productivity suite . They assist with consulting, custom Power Apps/Power Automate development, and hands-on staff training.[[1]](https://www.google.com/searchviewer/10?svid=CAwSHRIbCgNwdnESFENnMHZaeTh4TVdSNk1HaGpNWEJ3GAo)
- **[Bremmar](https://bremmar.com.au/microsoft-power-automate-brisbane/)** : A prominent Queensland Microsoft partner known for rolling out Power Automate and cloud transformation architectures, particularly serving complex sectors like not-for-profits, aged care, and disability services in the Brisbane region.[[1]](https://bremmar.com.au/microsoft-power-automate-brisbane/)

To help narrow down which of these partners aligns best with your needs, could you share:

- What **systems or software** (e.g., SharePoint, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, SQL) do you need Power Automate to integrate with?
- What is the rough **scale of your organization** (SME, Enterprise, or Public Sector)?
